_about: The race view's sounds (race-view/race-sound.js). files: each sound; 'loop' is the loop's length in seconds (the file carries half a second of the loop either side of it, so it loops without a click). Every file is made by tools/sound/make_race_sounds.py and can be swapped for a real recording of the same kind: for a loop, keep the half second either side and give its length here. mix: each layer's loudest level. crowd: how the crowd follows the race (the race view works out the excitement, 0 quiet to 1 roaring, from the timeline): quiet is the crowd's level before and between races; it starts to build buildFrom metres out and is roaring by buildTo; closeFinish adds to it in the last closeFrom metres when the first two are within closeLengths; passingStands adds when the leader is near the crowd (a long race passing the stands); after the line it holds the roar for peakHold seconds and settles over settle seconds; replay is its level in the replay, duck how loud the crowd is then. near: a camera within nearFrom metres of the crowd hears it fully, at farAt or more it's at farLevel and muffled to farMuffle Hz. hooves: full at nearAt metres from the nearest horse, gone by farAt, as the shot looks (the distance is scaled by the camera's field of view against lensFov degrees, so a long lens on far horses sounds near, as on TV), never below railMics while they gallop; cruise is the gallop's speed (m/s) at which the loop plays at its own speed. Owner, 12 Nov 2026: crowd sounds first; spoken commentary later.
